audit_implementation.midi_parser: Independent direct SMF bytes, VLQ and running-status decoder; mido not imported.

limits: This audit does not import or rerun the frozen estimator, generator, source loader, scorer or summary helpers.
Original MIDI attacks, velocities, source clocks, input identities and admission summaries are independently decoded from exact source bytes.
Per-fit residuals, synthetic per-event correctness primitives and model-derived pair-distance values are reported ledger inputs here; a separate model audit recomputes them from observations.
Every published aggregate, family partition, candidate policy, gain/loss count, AUC, nearest tie and retrieval decision is independently checked from those ledger inputs.
No acoustic or MIDI export/replay validation is performed. Original MIDI controllers are counted, not acoustically interpreted.
Actual GMD labels identify common beat instructions, not a canonical written score. Profile retrieval is closed-set and discards bar order.
Synthetic expression and clock transformations are authored controls; dependent cases and pairs do not establish population confidence or perceived naturalness.
